claim: For the second calendar quarter of 2024, Visa posted $8.9 billion of revenue.
summary: Visa's quarter ended June 30, 2024, which is the second calendar quarter of 2024, reported revenue of $8.9 billion, matching the claim.

sub_claims.text: Visa posted $8.9 billion of revenue for the second calendar quarter of 2024 (April-June 2024).
sub_claims.note: From own knowledge without external citations: Visa fiscal Q3 2024 corresponds to calendar Q2 2024 (April-June 2024) and reported net revenues of ~$8.9 billion.
